model: Original ictal D2 SourceA0, rank4 source correction, 9221 parameters, patient_z retained
reuse_reason: The original five-fold seed42 checkpoints and outer predictions are already frozen; reuse them without any modification
fold_seed_rule: seed + 1009 * fold; preserve the original model's internal 42+7000+fold_seed generator rule
split: Exactly the original fixed five outer folds, FIT/validation/TEST membership unchanged
changes: Training random seed only: model initialization, dropout and patient update order; no hyperparameter or split changes
preprocessing: Original patient_z, then stored FIT-only imputer and StandardScaler from the original per-fold BANK_PRIVATE.pt
training: Unmodified historical train.py: CUDA; AdamW lr0.001 wd0.0001; patient-equal optimizer updates; FIT-only NEZ BCE class weight; source penalty0.001; clip1; max30 min6 patience6
selection: Original validation-only threshold grid0.005 and tie rules; checkpoint validation Macro-F1/EZ-F1/earlier epoch. Each seed/fold selects its own threshold on validation only
primary_unit: Patient-equal outer metrics over the same 80 patients / 7635 channels, each patient once per seed
summary: Arithmetic mean and sample standard deviation (ddof=1) of five seed-level patient-equal metrics, not pooled fold mean and not score ensemble
freeze: All 25 checkpoint/bank/threshold bindings before new TEST inference; seal all 25 TEST prediction artifacts before loading full-cohort y
label_orientation: EZ=0 NEZ=1; sigmoid(NEZ logit); EZ prediction iff score < own validation threshold
ranking: Ascending NEZ probability; stable canonical channel-string ties
publication: Only code and compact aggregate audits/results; never patient/channel records, raw EEG, caches, checkpoints, predictions, runtime logs or secrets
